# Corpus

`source_register.csv` is the Source Register (Annex B) used to seed the system on first boot; `fixtures/` holds
**synthetic** documents generated by `scripts/build_fixtures.py` (`synthetic=Y`). They exist so that conflict,
supersession, upcoming changes, scope, tables, OCR and prompt-injection can be tested; **they are not official
documents and must not be presented as such.**

| doc_id | level | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| FIX-REG-2024 | 1 regulation | base rules: 75 % attendance (7.2), 40 % pass mark (8.1), grade table (8.2), supplementary eligibility (9.1) and procedure (9.2), degree requirement (10.1), cross-reference "subject to clause 7.4" |
| FIX-CIR-2026-08 | 2 circular | explicitly supersedes `FIX-REG-2024#7.2` -> 80 % from 2026-08-01 |
| FIX-FAQ-2026 | 4 FAQ | says 65 % attendance is enough and a 14-day supplementary deadline: lower authority, must not win |
| FIX-CIR-2027-01 | 2 circular | supersedes the 80 % clause -> 85 % from 2027-01-01 (an *upcoming change* before that date) |
| FIX-PLC-2026 | 2 circular | placement: CGPA >= 6.5, no active backlogs; **batch 2023 only** (2024 students have no applicable rule) |
| FIX-NOTICE-ECE-A / -B | 3 notices | re-evaluation within 3 vs 5 working days, same authority and date, ECE only: unresolvable -> `conflict_flagged` |
| FIX-INJECT-NOTICE | 3 notice | library fine + an embedded "ignore all previous instructions..." sentence that must be neutralised |
| FIX-SCAN-NOTICE | 3 notice | image-only PDF page: requires OCR |

## Adding real documents

1. Copy the PDFs into `corpus/real/` (or any folder under `corpus/`).
2. Add a row per document to `source_register.csv` with the Annex B columns plus `filename` (relative to `corpus/`):
   `doc_id, title, issuer, authority_level (1-5), doc_type (regulation|circular|notice|faq|handbook|unofficial),
   version, effective_from (YYYY-MM-DD), effective_to, supersedes (DOC-ID or DOC-ID#clause, ;-separated),
   scope_programmes, scope_batches, provenance (URL), retrieved_on, synthetic (Y|N), filename`.
3. `python scripts/ingest.py --corpus` (idempotent; unchanged files are skipped) or `POST /ingest` for one document.

Rules: only public official documents; no document containing real personal data (result lists with names or roll
numbers); at most 2 synthetic documents in the submitted corpus.
